notes.title: 1st Anniversary & Android App Released
notes.content:
It's been a year since launch
Thanks for playing this game

To commemorate that, an Android app will be released

It's basically the same as the Steam version, with the following differences:
- You can play for free, but ads will be displayed
- User interface and difficulty have been changed for smartphones
- Image quality and sound quality deteriorate
- Loading time is likely to be long (animal photos will be displayed)
- There are no achievements and extras

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Rusimitu.HyperTreasure

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Once you clear the game, you can return to the previous areas, and will be able to redo certain mistakes (some areas cannot be returned)
Along with that, also a discount will start soon

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1256040/
